name: SambaNova Cloud
tagline: High-throughput LLM inference on SambaNova RDU hardware
description: SambaNova Cloud is a high-throughput generative AI inference platform that serves open-source and proprietary LLMs on SambaNova Reconfigurable Dataflow Units (RDUs). Developers call an OpenAI-compatible REST API for chat completions and related endpoints, with self-serve API keys, model selection, and enterprise-grade throughput for production workloads.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (OpenAI-compatible). Keys created in SambaNova Cloud console after signup.

pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and enterprise plans; see cloud.sambanova.ai pricing for current rates

use_cases: run chat completions with OpenAI-compatible API against SambaNova models
stream high-throughput LLM responses for production apps
switch model IDs for Llama and other hosted open models
benchmark or offload inference to RDU-backed endpoints
